model_annotation: Figure 4 presents two bar charts, labeled (a) and (b), which illustrate the distribution of first-level semantic domains for verbs across four distinct media genres: 新闻 (News), 传统文学 (Traditional Literature), 网络小说 (Online Novels), and 微博 (Weibo). In both charts, the horizontal axis lists these four genres in that fixed order, while the vertical axis, labeled “频次” (Frequency), is linear and scaled from 0 to 2000, with major tick marks at intervals of 1000. Chart (a), titled “各语体中支配动词的一级语义域分布” (Distribution of first-level semantic domains for支配 verbs across genres), displays stacked bars for each genre, where each segment represents a different semantic domain, color-coded and labeled with both its absolute frequency and its percentage of the total for that genre; for instance, in News, the largest segment is “行为” (Action) with 567 occurrences (56%), followed by “心理” (Psychological) with 438 occurrences (43%). Chart (b), titled “各语体中承受动词的一级语义域分布” (Distribution of first-level semantic domains for承受 verbs across genres), follows the same structure and axis definitions, showing the distribution for承受 verbs; here, in News, “行为” (Action) again dominates with 700 occurrences (56%), followed by “心理” (Psychological) with 535 occurrences (43%). Both charts use identical color coding for the semantic domains, which are listed in a legend to the right of chart (b), and the bars for each genre are not sorted by height but are arranged according to the fixed order of semantic domains defined in the legend.
